review_text: The staff were rude and impolite. The beef rendang and Thai chicken curry were extremely spicy—so much that they were almost inedible. I have tried so many rendang from different places, it is not that spicy at all! When we approached a staff member named "Kat" about our concern, she simply agreed that their rendang is indeed spicy and immediately walked away without offering any explanation, alternative, or assistance. It was disappointing to be dismissed so casually instead of having our feedback acknowledged properly. The food and service both fell below our expectations. Poor airconditioning system! 0/10 on all aspects! When we asked for glass for the service water, it was as if she didn't even want to give me a glass and almost hesitant to give me ice when i politely asked.

This tiny cafe has a thick menu book complete with ample pictures of their appealing beverages and food items. Each food item seems good for one person. The Thai Curry bowl was a positive choice for a first-timer like me. Reasonably-priced with the size of each serving . Their best-selling Mocha frappe was super rich and thick. I took out two pasta plates which I think was overdone…. Still, will definitely visit again to try others on the menu. Staff was nice too.

What I like the most here is it's open 24/7 so anytime you're craving coffee, you can come here. Went for a breakfast run and ordered pancakes. Pancakes were okay. It's a little bit sweet for me but the whipped cream kinda balanced the flavors. Ordered the fruit cake and java chip frappe for takeout and did not disappoint. One of the best blends I have ever tasted here in Davao. You can really taste the coffee beans and the cake was heavenly. It was fluffy and the cream was not too sweet. The fruits were fresh and the flavors are well balanced. Overall, this place is highly recommended.

Limited food on menu but I've fried their Chicken mushroom and Beef rice bowl, the best! Nice drinks too. We came around 11am and the aircon is off, it's hot during our training/seminar (until 4pm) so I guess they have to improve on that but as a whole, I had a good experience. Plus it's a walking distance to SM, like literally across the road.

We checked out Space-Arabica coffee shop for a change of pace. The place was packed, but we managed to snap a pic with the friendly baristas and tried their hazelnut latte and other drink (can't remember). The atmosphere was more like a coworking space with students everywhere, but the drinks were good. The ambiance wasn't our vibe, but it's great for those looking for a quiet place to work. It wasn't the place for us, but we'd stop by again just for the drinks. An interesting experience, but not quite our scene. (As Titas)

Space Arabica is a coffee shop located on Ecoland Road in Davao City, directly across from SM City. This coffee shop has two floors with comfortable seating. Space Arabica's location is quite strategic, but the parking lot is not very spacious. If you're coming by car, it's best to come during off-peak hours. Space Arabica offers a variety of coffee drinks, from black coffee to coffee with various toppings. They also have tea drinks and food. I ordered a hazelnut espresso and a vanilla latte. The coffee was strong and suited my taste. I found the prices of the drinks at Space Arabica to be standard. Facilities Space Arabica provides Wi-Fi and electricity for visitors who bring laptops. Interior Space Arabica's interior isn't particularly striking for posting on social media. However, the atmosphere is decent for working on a laptop. Conclusion Overall, I was quite satisfied with my experience at Space Arabica. The coffee was delicious, the prices were standard, and the facilities were quite complete.
